lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the five gill slits, with the most prominent nodes aligned along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, with primary circular blobs serving as anchor nodes at the intersection points of these vertical bands and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and a shadow cast immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: A small yellow object or organism is attached at the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin; a second larger, elongated organism (remora) is visible trailing the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
